notes: Confirmed against full body and caller. The helper requires a valid input/context, reads a signed 16-bit record value at +0x98 and a global 16-bit value at 0x7004651350, reduces each through reciprocal-multiply sequences implementing modulo 7, and exits when the residues differ (main_0058.c:44141-44176). On a match it gets a value, divides by 7.0, and calls the already accepted recompute_attribute_record_value helper (0x70007433d0; main_0058.c:44177-44182). The caller repeatedly invokes this on a pointer after a validity check (main_0058.c:43953-43960). The proposed name accurately captures the guarded recomputation; no field/prototype claim is being reviewed.

Leave the semantic name blank. The body reads and clears a byte flag at input+0xbd09, then on a clear flag checks status 10, initializes/uses a temporary output through a global context helper twice with selector values 0 and 1, conditionally passes those temporary values to another helper, clears the flag, and calls a final helper (main_0166.c:50740-50780). Its caller passes the input object but does not clarify what the flag or two operations represent (main_0166.c:50730-50732). A narrower source-level role is not established.

Leave the semantic name blank. The body initializes/reads a context-like object and walks a pointer list; for each entry it may query two player attribute IDs, obtain nested-provider values, compare them and a helper result against zero, and eventually returns a boolean (main_0036.c:35520-35614). The caller passes a context pointer and an index/value, then branches on the returned boolean (main_0036.c:35278-35290). These checks establish a predicate but not its domain meaning or exact qualifying rule, so a more semantic name would overstate the evidence.

Leave the semantic name blank. The body obtains a mode-dependent count, sets up a global context and loops over indexed entries; it checks a status/attribute value, calls a helper with selector 0x11, and tests whether a nested pointer at +0x30 is present before continuing. It ultimately returns a boolean (main_0109.c:6224-6293). The caller consumes that boolean in a branch but does not identify the aggregate condition (main_0109.c:5852-5854). The exact predicate is not supported strongly enough to name.

Leave the semantic name blank. The body rejects invalid input, a failed status check, and mode values outside 0..5; it performs a strided-table lookup, gets a value using selector 0xd, invokes two additional object helpers, and returns whether one integer result is at least another (main_0056.c:8066-8112). Its caller branches on the result (main_0056.c:7930-7932), but the compared values and domain purpose are unresolved. A generic predicate description would not add a useful semantic name.
